facts.fact: Commission president Omar Seghrouchni said at a Kenitra meeting that effective application of Law 31.13 depends on better knowledge of its provisions, and commission member Abderrahim Fakkahi criticised the wording of its Article 10.
The Commission du droit d'accès à l'information (CDAI), with a president and members, held a regional meeting at Kenitra on 7 November 2026 as the body overseeing the right of access.
